quickref.status: BBG 2.7 (Jan 23 2014); listed in the 2026 Closed Playtest #4 Gear Up [Observed]

quickref.firing_and_projectile: Semi-auto hitscan, 3-round clip [Fan-wiki; HUD Observed]. Instant thin STRAIGHT magenta-pink beam with a white core, about #E061C3 to #F96DFF [Observed: dgSVmVGMYAQ thumbnail, BJQS1vCgLxc 68 s, jXdcze9skQY 56 s, y6TUr1Ffg5w thumbnail]
quickref.impact_end_result: No explosion [Game text via wiki]; a small white flash (#ECF7F9) at the target, or a white glow with a pale-yellow rim (#EBD595) and white puffs [Observed]; 50 dmg [Fan-wiki]; kill look not observed

quickref.status: BBG 2.3 (2013); in the 2026 Closed Playtest #4 list; 2026 text says 'RECEIVED' [Observed]
quickref.look: Rounded black-and-orange backpack with four white hexagonal pods [dossier]
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Activated self-buff, 2 charges, 5 s reload, 2 s duration (6 s before 2020) [Fan-wiki]; no projectile

quickref.status: 2013 launch default; wiki marks it REMOVED; not among the visible 2026 secondaries [Observed; scroll caveat]
quickref.look: Gold-orange lattice backpack with black panels and dark discs [Observed: mX-wRChpK1w, NJKRl54kc54]
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Hold fire 3 s (official) or 4 s (wiki) to self-destruct; moving cancels [Fan-wiki]; arms spread wide in the frame before detonation [Observed; pose meaning Inference]; no projectile

quickref.status: BBG 2.7 (2014); in the 2026 list and equipped in a 2026 loadout [Observed]
quickref.look: Glossy white orb (#FDFEF9) docked on the upper back in an orange octagonal cradle (#AA7B2B) with cyan light pads (#14C8F3); stays docked while firing [Observed: 6zv-C5K11i4]
quickref.firing_and_projectile: 'Fires missiles whenever he fires' [Game text via wiki; same text in-game in 2026, Observed]; 2 or 8 missiles at 1,500 u/s [Fan-wiki, conflicting]; candidate white-lavender streaks rising from behind his shoulders (DNcZwCdJSIk 44/54 s) [Observed; attribution Unverified]
quickref.impact_end_result: Explosive, 20-50 dmg with AoE 125/250 since 2020 [Fan-wiki]; candidate white starbursts with pale-pink rays at targets [Observed; attribution Unverified]

quickref.status: 2013 launch default; in fan clips 2013-2018 and in build 2.53.6 (Sep 8, 2022)
quickref.look: Orange-and-white octagonal launcher on the right forearm, about 0.6x Oliver long. Black muzzle tube, orange riveted collar (~#D98628), black ribbed hose looping down the outer side. Back end: an orange-rimmed black octagon [Observed]. The four-vent disc seen on the back is the Energy Barrier, not part of the gun [Observed].
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Lobbed arcing grenades, 1.5 s (infobox) or 1 s (prose) per shot, 5 s reload [Fan-wiki]. On reload a lemon-gold orb (core ~#F5FCEC to #FFFF80) swells on the muzzle, 3-4x the muzzle's width [Observed]. Projectile: a white orb with an orange-yellow flame tongue to a small spark, and a chain of yellow-orange beads [Observed in one still; ID by Inference].
quickref.impact_end_result: Big low-poly faceted burst: white core with lemon-yellow facets (~#FDFE40 to #FFFF4C) and flying white cubes [Observed; attribution Inference]. Damage 45-70, large AoE, knockback on airborne targets, self-harm risk [Fan-wiki]. The same style is shared by other BBG explosives [Observed].

quickref.status: Equipped in a live match in the official 'BBG Livestream', Aug 21, 2026 (HUD 4/4, Sky Pirates) [Observed]; on the loadout screen with an axe [Observed]; Nov 4 shipping [Unverified]
quickref.look: The same orange-and-white launcher and the same HUD icon as in 2013-2022 [Observed: loadout and HUD only; no close 3D view of the 2026 model]
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Not observed in 2026 [Unverified]. Use the 2013-2022 behaviour.
quickref.impact_end_result: No 2026 Grenader blast found [Unverified]. 2026 explosions from other weapons are lemon and white faceted bursts (~#FBFF74 / #FEFEFC) [Observed].

quickref.status: Added in BBG 2.3 [Fan-wiki]; on B-1000 backs 2014-2022 [Observed]
quickref.look: White disc on the upper back with FOUR dark vents in white hex sleeves around orange V and inverted-V panels [Observed]
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Activated ability: 2.0 s, 2 charges, 5 s reload; the wearer glows team-coloured [Fan-wiki]. No projectile.
quickref.impact_end_result: The wearer takes 50% less damage for 2 s [Game text via wiki / Fan-wiki]. The glow was not observed [Unverified].
